description: One sports capper's record, looked up by X (Twitter) handle: wins, losses and units over the last 30 days on the picks Slipstream tracks, dated, with their place on the standings and a link to their page. Use it when someone asks whether a capper is winning or what their record is. A handle Slipstream does not track returns a link to the standings.

handle.description: The capper's X handle, with or without the @.
